label: flash-materials-final-consistency-20261005-10
scope: Independent counterexamples in completed intermediate design only. Integration/review may repair these. This is not a final content verdict and does not edit any planning state.

findings.finding: AppController.init still sets isInitialized=true before binding, render and focus. The actual draft specifies only dependency-missing failure and forbids repeated calls; render/focus failure and safe initialization retry are not closed.

captureSnapshot failure now enters catch, but the public rollback signature accepts a non-null snapshot while handleReset promises to invoke it even when captureSnapshot has not returned. The sample handles null; the method contract still needs the same explicit no-snapshot branch.
